messages.subject: Error in importing the spss file in lavaan
parts:
hello everyone,

I am a new user for this software (even I don't know much about coding or so). I have installed lavaan in my system (Window 7).
The problem occurs while importing my existing spss file in lavaan. The error message shows "line 2 did not have 10 elements". What does this signify? I do not have any missing data for anything like that in my spss file. How will I solve the problem?

Kindly guide.

Thanks,
Sayoni

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: Error in importing the spss file in lavaan
parts:
This is a very literal error message. Look at row 2 of the data file.
     This might be a problem with headers. (You don't say exactly how you imported the SPSS file, so I'm guessing.) But data written from a stats program may have a row of headers or variable labels first, and then rows of data. Each row of data may have a row label (maybe just 1, 2, 3 . . .), so the rows of data will have one more element than the header row. If this is the case, then you might set an option on the function which read the file, so that it knows whether or not you have row labels and headers.
     Or maybe one of the variable labels has a space in it.
     If the file is not terribly large, look into the read.clipboard function. You can copy your data rectangle to the clipboard and then read that into R:

https://www.rdocumentation.org/packages/psych/versions/1.6.6/topics/read.clipboard
